author: TECHDEV
description: Is this install exposed to the GPGME double-free (CVE-2026-129975)? A zero-dependency CLI that decides from the three live conditions together: installed GPGME version vs the 20/11/2026 fixed builds (2.3.1 upstream, 1.24.4 legacy, pinned distro backports), linkage type (shared/DLL/static), and operator-declared exposure context.
name: gpgme2shell

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/unit.test.js test/e2e.test.js
